Prerequisites: @UUID[Compendium.ptu.references.Item.gXCUs0TgA8u0cOzf]
Daily – Swift Action
Effect: Take X injuries, where X is from 1 to 9. Your size increases in a Burst 1 around yourself if there is room, pushing any creatures out of the way to the nearest unoccupied space. Until the end of the Scene, you gain a +2*X bonus to all Damage Rolls. You also gain 5*X Temporary Hit Points.
